name: Grand Archive TCG: Distorted Reflections Alter Edition Booster Display (24 Boosters) - EN
description:
Tumble back down the rabbit hole and return to Underland with this special set. It's a delight to see our heroes in a whole new light-and to discover the wondrous Forest of Clubs, where even more surprises await.
Distorted Reflections Alter Edition is a reprint set that adds 40 unique cards, alternate art URs, and brand-new CSRs to collect!
Product Info:
• 280 unique cards in set
• 261 foil variations in set
• 15 randomly inserted cards per pack
• 24 booster packs per booster box
• 6 booster boxes per case
